def csr(self, g, want_kind=False):
        """Lineage-graph adjacency for guard ``g`` as python lists.

        The merged edge arrays are sorted by source state, so a guard mask
        keeps that order and a bincount is a valid CSR grouping.
        """
        pos = np.nonzero((self.e_gmax >= g) & self.e_bl)[0]
        posl = pos.tolist()
        dst = self.e_dst[pos].tolist()
        srcg = self.e_src[pos]
        w = list(map(self.e_wpy.__getitem__, posl))
        kind_src = pos if want_kind else None
        del pos, posl
        cnt = np.bincount(srcg, minlength=self.nstates)
        del srcg
        indptr = np.zeros(self.nstates + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        indptr[1:] = np.cumsum(cnt)
        del cnt
        kind = self.e_kind[kind_src].tolist() if want_kind else None
        return indptr.tolist(), dst, w, kind
